publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: One kernel, different products
record.method: Archive metadata and full-byte hash comparison
record.observation: The inspected iPhone and iPod touch 1.1.4/4A102 archives contain a byte-identical kernelcache. Their board trees, bootloaders and primary root images differ.
record.limits: Shared kernel identity does not establish cross-product userspace, peripheral or telephony compatibility.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

exhibits.title: Identify the two archives
exhibits.interpretation: Both identify 1.1.4 / 4A102. Archive identity is independent of whether either product boots on a particular model.

exhibits.title: What actually matches
exhibits.interpretation: A shared kernel does not erase the board and root-image differences.
